model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промените в съотношението на разреденост (sparsity ratio) на изхода на SDPA при различни етапи от обработка, като функцията е прагът от $10^{-2}$. 

Оста X е означена като "Слой" (Layer) и има скала със стойности от 0 до 22, като всеки етикет представлява цяло число и показва равномерно разпределение.

Оста Y е означена като "Коефициент на разреденост" (Sparsity Ratio) и има скала със стойности от 0 до 1.0, с етикети през интервали от 0.2.

В графиката са представени три линии: 
- Първата линия е с цвят синьо и пунктирна линия (sparsity ratio before gate; avg 0.03). Тя започва при стойност малко над 0.1 на слой 0 и бързо намалява до стойност под 0.05 още на слой 1. След това остава почти плоска и близка до 0 до края на графиката на слой 22.
- Втората линия е с цвят оранжево и пунктирна линия (sparsity ratio after gate; avg 0.44). Тя започва при стойност малко под 0.95 на слой 0 и постепенно намалява до около 0.4 на слой 22 с няколко върха и спадове по средата.
- Третата линия е с цвят зелено и пунктирна линия (sparsity ratio after average gate; avg 0.33). Тя започва при стойност малко под 1.0 и бързо спада до около 0.25 на слой 5, след което остава почти постоянна до слой 22 с малки колебания.

Всеки от върховете и спадовете е визуално описан според позицията му на графиката, без да се правят заключения за причините или значенията им.
model_annotations.Chinese: The figure shows the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis represents the layer, with a range from 0 to 23, marked with integer values at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, with a range from 0.0 to 1.0, marked with values from 0.0 to 1.0 at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines in the graph: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03; an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44; and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33. The blue line starts around 0.15 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 5, remaining relatively stable near 0.0 from layer 10 onwards. The orange line starts at 0.95 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.35 at layer 5, fluctuates between 0.25 and 0.45 from layer 5 to 20, and increases to around 0.4 at layer 23. The green line starts at 0.95 at layer 0, decreases steeply to around 0.35 at layer 5, and then stabilizes around 0.2 from layer 10 to 23, with minor fluctuations.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis, representing the layer, has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5, and no units are specified. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," also has a linear scale with values from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44, and a green dash-dot line for the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and decreases to near 0 by layer 5, remaining near 0 across the layers. The orange line starts at 0.95 and decreases to about 0.25 by layer 5, then fluctuates, reaching 0.35 at layer 23. The green line starts at 0.95 and decreases to about 0.35 by layer 5, then slightly increases and fluctuates, ending at approximately 0.25 by layer 23.
model_annotations.German:
The diagram depicts the sparsity ratio of SDPA output, comparing three different lines representing distinct stages of the process. The x-axis represents the layer, ranging from 0 to 23, with no units specified. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. 

The diagram includes three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line begins at approximately 0.15 and decreases to approximately 0.01. The orange line begins at approximately 0.98 and decreases to approximately 0.25, with fluctuations. The green line begins at approximately 0.98 and decreases to approximately 0.15.
